# `<net/protocols/nic.h>`

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Shared memory and doorbell protocol between a NIC driver and netd.

```c
#include <net/protocols/nic.h>
```

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="nic_doorbell_tx"></a>`NIC_DOORBELL_TX` | `(1u << 0)` | Doorbell bit, netd to driver: frames queued in the tx ring. |
| <a id="nic_doorbell_rx"></a>`NIC_DOORBELL_RX` | `(1u << 1)` | Doorbell bit, driver to netd: frames queued in the rx ring. |
| <a id="nic_stats_offset"></a>`NIC_STATS_OFFSET` |  | Offset of the [NicStatsBlock](#nicstatsblock): in the rx ring's pages, just after the ring. |

## Enumerations

### `NicStat` { #nicstat }

Driver statistics counters.

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `NIC_STAT_IRQ` | `0` | Interrupts serviced. |
| `NIC_STAT_RX_PACKETS` | `1` | Frames delivered to the rx ring. |
| `NIC_STAT_TX_PACKETS` | `2` | Frames written to the hardware tx FIFO. |
| `NIC_STAT_RX_RING_FULL` | `3` | Frames dropped because the rx ring was full. |
| `NIC_STAT_RX_ERRORS` | `4` | Received frames the NIC flagged as bad. |
| `NIC_STAT_RX_OVERSIZE` | `5` | Received frames dropped for exceeding NIC_FRAME_SIZE. |
| `NIC_STAT_TX_DROPS` | `6` | Frames dropped because the tx FIFO was full. |
| `NIC_STAT_COUNT` | `7` | Number of counters. |

## Structures
